workItem: 77.44.7.A — Inspector required and trim value contract
finding: Every registered Inspector value normalizer trims leading/trailing whitespace and rejects an empty value, but the machine-readable value contract did not declare either policy.
change: All supported Inspector value contracts now declare required=true and trimmed=true. Unsupported contracts do not claim either behavior. The existing project-owned normalizer remains the single validation source; no third-party dependency was added.
